Icon.description: An icon a user interface can show.

mimeType.description: The image's MIME type, where its source omits it or gives a generic one.

sizes.description: The sizes the icon suits, each `WxH` or `any`. None listed means any size.

src.description: An HTTP(S) URL or a `data:` URI of the image.

theme.description: The background the icon is designed for. None means either.

IconTheme.description: The background an icon is designed for.

Tool.description: A tool, as the Model Context Protocol's tool record describes it.

_meta.description: Metadata beyond the record, each key prefixed by its owner's reverse-DNS name.

annotations.description: What calling the tool does to its environment.

description.description: What the tool does, which a model reads to decide whether and how to call it.

icons.description: Icons a user interface can show for the tool.

inputSchema.description: The JSON Schema a call's arguments satisfy. Its root is an object schema.

name.description: The tool's identity: 1 to 128 ASCII letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.`.

outputSchema.description: The JSON Schema the tool's structured result satisfies.

ToolAnnotations.description:
Hints at what calling a tool does to its environment. A hint is a claim of the tool's
author, not a guarantee.

destructiveHint.description: A tool that changes something may destroy or overwrite. Defaults to true.

idempotentHint.description:
A tool that changes something changes nothing more when called again with the same
arguments. Defaults to false.

openWorldHint.description: The tool reaches entities outside its own domain. Defaults to true.

readOnlyHint.description: The tool changes nothing. Defaults to false.

title.description: The name people read, where the tool itself has no title.
